cause: RT64 triangle readback bounds used cached RSP depth-write state, while raw RDP mode commands changed the state used for rasterization.
correction: Track triangle depth bounds using active RDP depth-write state.

visual_review.documentation: The original 181-frame planet comparison remains valid. The later Gemini-ship report was subsequently located and accepted; see later_ship_followup.
